method: Re-read both TSVs from raw text (no float caching). Recomputed residuals in 8 algebraically equivalent evaluation orders. Exact rational (fractions.Fraction) evaluation of the ratio on the printed decimals AND exact-rational OLS coefficients. Adversarial rounding-budget analysis: half-ulp of each magnitude's printed precision (hA=5e-7, hB=5e-8) propagated through dR/dA,dR/dB to bound the implied-response error, plus 20000-draw uniform +-5e-7 / +-half-ulp Monte Carlo over the rounding box and closed-form corner evaluation of the attainable R interval. Coincidence null via 400k independent draws. Fuzzy/byte duplicate scan of every column against A, B, A+B, B-A, A/B, A*B, R and the identity. Per-series (13-row block) residuals.
counterevidence: 1) The quoted set_4 residual 1.1e-16 is NOT produced by the canonical formula as written in the claim: (f5-f4)/(f5+f4) gives exactly 0.0 on all 91 rows. 2^53^-1 = 1.11e-16 arises only from an algebraically equivalent but differently-rounded evaluation order, e.g. (B-A)*np.reciprocal(B+A), (B-A)*(B+A)**-1, or B/(A+B)-A/(A+B), which differ on 15/91 rows. So the claim understates exactness for set_4 and quotes an implementation artefact rather than a data property. 2) The task's literal perturbation test ('does printed R stay within its OWN ~1e-16 rounding interval under +-5e-7 magnitude perturbation') FAILS: 0% of rows in both panels, because the achievable R spread over that box is 2.7e-8/4.1e-8, ~1e8x wider than 1e-16. That test is mis-posed - it is uninformative because the perturbation interval dwarfs the residual. The decisive comparison is residual vs the magnitude-rounding BUDGET (3.4e-7/2.2e-7): observed residual is 0.0, i.e. ~1e7x below the budget, which proves the printed magnitudes ARE the exact inputs used and rules out the 'more-precise-values-rounded-for-publication' alternative. 3) OLS on a*B/(A+B)+b returns a=2.000000000000002, b=-1.000000000000000 to -1.000000000000001, NOT bit-exact 2/-1; that is least-squares conditioning, not a real deviation - the canonical (B-A)/(A+B) form with a fixed at 1 and b at 0 attains residual exactly 0.0, and exact rational arithmetic gives a=2 and b=-1 exactly. 4) Alternative explanations tested and rejected: a Holling/Rosenzweig-type family a*B^p/(A^p+B^p) fits poorly (max|r| 0.12/0.19), as do a*B/A+b, a*log(B/A)+b, a*B+b, a*A+b (max|r| 0.018-0.34). 5) The 'B is the driver' reading is an artefact: corr(R,B)=0.31/0.43 and R2=0.09/0.19, but B and the true argument A/B are only weakly related (corr(B,A/B)=-0.30/-0.41) while the ratio alone explains 99.3-99.8% of variance; the naive attribution is induced by A-B collinearity (corr 0.878/0.879) and the limited B/A range. 6) The residual has exactly zero variance, so no series label (numeric_feature_1, 8 series / 7 series) can explain any part of it. 7) Extra finding supporting 'no independent content': in observation_set_3, numeric_feature_6 is a byte-identical duplicate of the response numeric_feature_5 across all 104 rows.
